one_line: A 5th-century Buddhist-trained scribe-physician in Kucha who copies and transmits Indian medical recipes along Central Asian trade and monastery routes.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean and slightly bookish build
appearance.face: Oval face with warm light-brown complexion, straight nose, fine dark brows, faint ink smudge often on one cheek, and a calm, focused default expression that softens into a small knowing half-smile.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair gathered into a low knot at the back of the head, with a few loose strands at the temples, wrapped in a narrow dusty-red cloth headband that ties at the back and leaves short tails hanging.
appearance.costume: A long, simple Central Asian Buddhist-style robe inspired by 5th–6th century Kucha wall paintings: inner knee-length tunic of undyed off-white cotton or linen with a round neck and narrow cuffs, over it a wrap-around outer robe in soft muted teal-blue wool crossing left over right and belted at the waist with a plain brown leather belt; wide but neat sleeves that reach the wrist; loose sand-coloured trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitching; over the left shoulder, a saffron-ochre cotton shawl (evoking a monk’s mantle) draped neatly and modestly, with a thin darker border; minimal jewellery, just a small plain bronze ring on the right hand and a single dark wooden mala bracelet on the left wrist.
appearance.signature: A roll of palm-leaf and birch-bark manuscript tied with a thin cord, carried together with a slender bamboo pen case holding reed pens and a small travel inkwell, usually held in one hand or tucked at the belt.

ref_desc: Light-brown oval-faced man in his mid-30s with black hair in a low knot and a dusty-red headband, wearing an off-white tunic, muted teal-blue wrap robe, saffron-ochre shoulder shawl, sand trousers and brown boots, carrying a tied manuscript roll with bamboo pen case.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of a mid-30s light-brown–skinned man from 5th–6th century Kucha, lean and slightly bookish, with an oval face, straight nose, calm focused expression, and a faint ink smudge on one cheek; give him straight black hair gathered into a low knot at the back and wrapped with a narrow dusty-red cloth headband whose tails hang short behind, with a few loose strands at his temples; dress him in an era-accurate Central Asian Buddhist-inspired outfit: an inner knee-length off-white cotton or linen tunic with a round neck and narrow cuffs, over which he wears a muted teal-blue wool wrap robe crossing left over right and secured by a plain brown leather belt at the waist, the robe’s sleeves wide but neat and reaching the wrists, and loose sand-coloured trousers tucked into simple mid-calf brown leather boots; drape a saffron-ochre cotton shawl with a slightly darker border over his left shoulder like a monk’s mantle, keeping the overall look modest and fully clothed; add a small bronze ring on his right hand and a dark wooden mala bracelet on his left wrist; in one hand or tucked at his belt, show his signature prop: a carefully tied palm-leaf and birch-bark manuscript roll together with a slender bamboo pen case holding reed pens and a tiny travel inkwell; use a palette dominated by muted teal-blue, saffron-ochre, off-white, sand brown, and dark brown, and present him front-facing with clear views of his hairstyle, outfit, and writing tools for consistent redrawing.
